title: QOut
description:
All programs need Input and Output. Otherwise how do you know they do anything? In Quantum C: you output to console with somthing called `std::qout`. All you do is type: 
```cpp
std::qout << "Text you want to output";
```
---
You can also output an aditional newline after (basically the enter key) by typing another ` << ` followed by the text '\n'. \n is somthing called an _Escape Sequence_. A Escape sequence is a special series of characters that starts with a backslash that represents a character. Exmples:
- \n: Newline.
- \\: A backslash.
- \t: a tab.
These are how you print special characters.
